info.title: Elixir Books ERP API
info.summary: REST contract for the Elixir Books ERP (all 19 modules)
info.description:
Versioned REST API for **Elixir Books** — multi-tenant, multi-company ERP covering CRM, Sales,
Purchase, Inventory, POS, Projects & Contracts, Production, Accounting, Banking, Taxation
(India GST / e-Invoice / e-Way bill / TDS), Payroll, Fixed Assets, Budgets & Expenses,
Reports & Consolidation, Masters, Company Administration and Platform Administration.

The contract is derived 1:1 from the front-end domain model (`src/store/types.ts`,
`src/modules/<module>/types.ts`) and the business engine / action functions
(`src/store/engine.ts`, `src/modules/<module>/*actions*.ts`). FRD §20–21 conventions apply.

## Conventions

| Concern | Rule |
|---|---|
| Base path | `/v1` (see `servers`) |
| Tenant | Derived from the bearer token / API key. Never sent explicitly. |
| Company scope | Header `X-Company-Id` is **required** on every company-scoped operation (everything except `/auth/*`, `/me*`, `/onboarding*`, `/companies`, `/platform/*`, `/health`, `/enums`). Optional `X-Branch-Id` selects the branch used for numbering / defaults. |
| Auth | `bearerAuth` (JWT from `/auth/login`) by default. `apiKeyAuth` (`X-API-Key`) is accepted on operations whose `x-permission` is covered by an API-key scope. |
| Permission | Every operation declares `x-permission` = `<module>.<resource>.<action>`; roles may hold wildcards (`sales.*`, `*.*.view`, `*`). Tenant owners and platform admins bypass. |
| Entitlement | Module must be in the tenant plan; otherwise `403 ENTITLEMENT_DENIED`. |
| Pagination | Cursor-based: `cursor`, `limit` (default 25, max 200), `sort=field:asc|desc` (deterministic id tie-break). Lists return `{ data, meta, scope }`. |
| Filters | Register filters map to query params: `q` (search keys), `status` (comma list), `dateFrom/dateTo`, `amountMin/amountMax`, `partyId`, `branchId`, `warehouseId`, plus resource-specific params. |
| Concurrency | Every record carries `version`. Draft/master edits send `expectedVersion`; mismatch → `409 CONFLICT`. |
| Idempotency | Operations marked `x-idempotent: true` require `Idempotency-Key`. Same key + same payload → original result replayed; same key + different payload → `409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT`. |
| Correlation | `X-Correlation-Id` accepted in, always returned, and echoed in every error body. |
| Errors | Single `Error` shape: `{ code, message, field?, path?, details?, correlationId }` with a stable `code` (see `ErrorCode`). Validation failures never leave partial journals, stock moves or jobs. |
| Periods | Any date-bound posting into a Soft Closed / Locked period → `423 PERIOD_LOCKED`. |
| Posted documents | Never edited or deleted — `reverse` (reason required) or `cancel` instead. |
| Money / dates | Money is a JSON number with 2 dp in document currency (`baseTotal` / `*Base` fields for company base currency); dates are `YYYY-MM-DD`, timestamps ISO-8601 UTC. |
| Workflow | `submit` on a document resolves the active `WorkflowRule` for its `x-workflow-doc-type`. No rule ⇒ approved/posted directly; rule ⇒ `ApprovalRequest` created and the document goes `Submitted`. Approvers act through `/approvals`. |
| Side effects | State-changing actions return an `ActionResult` (`document` + `journal`, `stockMovements`, `openItems`, `approval`, `reservations`, `warnings`) so consequences are visible to the caller. |
| Events | `x-events` on an operation lists the domain events published (delivered to registered webhooks — see **Webhooks**). |
| Generic sub-resources | Attachments, PDF, e-mail, posted/projected journal and activity are exposed once for every document type under `/documents/{collection}/{id}/…` (tag System) instead of being repeated per document. |
| Extensions | `x-permission`, `x-frd` (requirement ids), `x-idempotent`, `x-events`, `x-workflow-doc-type`, `x-platform-only`, `x-company-scoped`. |

## HTTP status ↔ error code

| Status | Codes |
|---|---|
| 400 | `VALIDATION` (required / format / bad cursor / bad filter) |
| 401 | `UNAUTHENTICATED`, `MFA_REQUIRED`, `AUTH_SUSPENDED`, `AUTH_DEACTIVATED`, `INVITE_PENDING` |
| 403 | `PERMISSION_DENIED`, `ENTITLEMENT_DENIED`, `TENANT_SUSPENDED`, `DENIED`, `SELF_APPROVAL`, `PLATFORM_ONLY` |
| 404 | `NOT_FOUND` (also for ids belonging to another tenant/company — no existence leakage) |
| 409 | `CONFLICT` (stale `expectedVersion`), `IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT`, `INVALID_STATE`, `ALREADY_REVERSED`, `DUPLICATE`, `REFERENCED`, `IN_USE`, `PENDING_APPROVAL`, `BLOCKED`, `INCOMPLETE`, `PLAN_LIMIT` |
| 410 | `EXPIRED` (invite / reset / export link) |
| 413 | `PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE` |
| 422 | Business rules: `UNBALANCED`, `EMPTY`, `INVALID_ACCOUNT`, `POSTING_NOT_ALLOWED`, `CONTROL_ACCOUNT`, `DIMENSION_REQUIRED`, `DIMENSION_PROHIBITED`, `NEGATIVE_STOCK`, `INSUFFICIENT_AVAILABLE`, `SERIAL_REQUIRED`, `SERVICE_ITEM`, `OVER_ALLOCATION`, `CREDIT_BLOCK`, `DUPLICATE_REFERENCE`, `WORKFLOW_REQUIRED`, `APPROVAL_REQUIRED`, `PARTY_BLOCKED`, `RATE_MISSING`, `SERIAL_DUP`, `BATCH_REQUIRED`, `NO_BOM`, `BOM_SUPERSEDED`, `HAS_ISSUES`, `HAS_RECEIPTS`, `HAS_OUTPUT`, `SUBCONTRACT_OPEN`, `PENDING_ELIMINATIONS`, `COMMENT_REQUIRED`, `EINV_NOT_READY`, `EINV_WINDOW`, `EWB_NOT_REQUIRED`, `MATCH_EXCEPTION`, `CHECKLIST_BLOCKED`, `MAKER_CHECKER`, `SCAN_BLOCKED`, `AMOUNT_MISMATCH`, `BOOKS_CHANGED`, `DUPLICATE_PERIOD`, `OVER_CONSUMPTION`, `OVER_QTY`, `QC_HOLD`, `SHORTFALL`, `ORDER`, `SAME_COMPANY` |
| 423 | `PERIOD_LOCKED`, `ACCOUNT_LOCKED` (MFA attempts exhausted) |
| 429 | `RATE_LIMITED` |
| 502 | `PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE` (IRP / EWB / GSTN / Bank / RateProvider / Email / SMS) |

post.summary: Approve / reject / return / delegate / recall
post.description:
- **Approve** → next step becomes Pending, or the request completes and the document goes `Approved`
  (admin doc types apply their post-approval effect: Period Reopen, Profile Change, Exchange Rate, Supplier Bank Detail).
- **Reject** → document `Rejected` (comment required).
- **Return** → document `Returned` to the requester for edits (comment required).
- **Delegate** → step reassigned to `delegateToUserId` (step must allow delegation).
- **Recall** → requester withdraws; document back to `Draft`.

The caller must be an approver of the current step (`403 DENIED`); requesters cannot approve their own
request unless the rule allows self-approval (`403 SELF_APPROVAL`).

WebhookEnvelope.description:
Every delivery is a `POST` to the subscription URL with this JSON body. Headers — `X-Elixir-Event` (event name), `X-Elixir-Delivery` (delivery id), `X-Elixir-Signature` (`t=<unix>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256 of "<t>.<raw body>" with the webhook secret>`), `X-Correlation-Id`.
Retries: exponential back-off (1 m, 5 m, 30 m, 2 h, 12 h) on non-2xx / timeout (10 s); after 10 consecutive failures the subscription is auto-paused. Deliveries are at-least-once — dedupe on `id`.

`sales.invoice.create`, `sales.order.create`, `sales.receipt.view`, `purchase.*`, `purchase.order.view`,

`reports.*`, `webhooks.manage`) and are accepted only on operations whose `x-permission` is covered by a scope.
